title: 第十章 室友竟不信清冷校花是我女友?
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

教学楼，101阶梯教室，一个戴着眼镜，穿着牛仔裤和青色体恤，年龄约摸着30岁出头的年轻老师站在讲台上，陆陆续续的学生从教室门外进来，客客气气的跟老师点点头，老师也一一回应。

陈舟一行人前前后后从教室门外走了进来，郭子峰话比较多，絮絮叨叨的整个教学楼都能听见，路灿话比较少，时不时地迎合两句。

毫无疑问，陈舟是宿舍里颜值最高的那个，眉眼清俊。路灿个子不高，但长相清秀，颇有种男生女相的感觉，郭子峰和李东则两人长得就有点像了，有些粗犷，但模样还算周正。

众人从门外一进教室，看见一个年纪不大的老师正坐在讲台上，也闭上了嘴巴，四人一前一后地找了个地方坐了下来。

陈舟跟室友来的比较早，到的时候教室座位空着一大半，几人坐在角落里，陈舟低着头玩着手机，郭子峰和李东则观察着从门外进来的女同学。

“快看，快看，这脸蛋。”

李东则是扬了扬下巴，指了指旁边的那个。

“这个也挺好看的。”

说完俩人用手肘戳了戳陈舟，脸上堆着笑，显然是打算让陈舟帮他们去联谊。

“陈哥，等会要是有女同学加你微信联谊，你可一定要答应啊！”

旁边的李东也附和道。

“对啊，对啊，兄弟们的幸福就靠你了！”

此刻的陈舟正低着头，指尖在屏幕飞舞。

【嘿嘿，舟舟，晚上甜蜜双排吗？】

【我和你说，我现在会玩貂蝉了，你晚上辅助我，我带你嘎嘎乱杀！】

看到这消息，陈舟不由得想到上次柠柠说自己现在玩虞姬，让自己辅助她，结果自己苏烈输出比她虞姬高，但他也没扫兴，毕竟柠柠也就刚王者，自己随便玩玩也乱杀。

他先回复了消息。

【好滴，但是我还不知道啥时候结束呢，我在开班会。】

回完消息后，陈舟发现李东和郭子峰正一脸祈求的看着他，他疑惑地问。

“你们说啥来着？”

郭子峰和李东毕竟是有求于人，把刚刚的话又重复了一遍。

“嘿嘿，陈哥，要有女生找你宿舍联谊，带上哥们呗。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the teaching building, Classroom 101, a young teacher in his early 30s wearing glasses, jeans and a blue T-shirt stood on the podium. Students came in one after another from outside the classroom door, nodding politely to the teacher, and the teacher responded one by one.

Chen Zhou and his group walked in from outside the classroom door one after another. Guo Zifeng talked more, and his ramblings could be heard throughout the teaching building. Lu Can talked less, and would cater a few words from time to time.

There is no doubt that Chen Zhou is the most handsome person in the dormitory, with handsome features.Lu Can is not tall, but has a delicate appearance, which gives him a boy-female look. Guo Zifeng and Li Dongze look a bit alike, a bit rugged, but still decent-looking.

As soon as everyone entered the classroom from the door, they saw a young teacher sitting on the podium and closed his mouth. The four of them found a place to sit down one after another.

Chen Zhou and his roommates came earlier. When they arrived, most of the classroom seats were empty. A few people were sitting in the corner. Chen Zhou lowered his head and played with his mobile phone, while Guo Zifeng and Li Dong observed the female classmates coming in from the door.

"Look, look, this face."

Li Dong raised his chin and pointed to the one next to him.

"This is pretty good-looking too."

After speaking, the two of them poked Chen Zhou with their elbows, with smiles on their faces, obviously planning to ask Chen Zhou to help them socialize.

"Brother Chen, if a female classmate joins you on WeChat later, you must agree!"

Li Dong next to him also echoed.

"Yes, yes, the happiness of my brothers depends on you!"

At this moment, Chen Zhou was lowering his head and his fingertips were flying on the screen.

[Hey, Zhouzhou, do you want to have a sweet double queue tonight?】

[Let me tell you, I can play Diao Chan now. You help me at night, and I will lead you to kill!】

Seeing this news, Chen Zhou couldn't help but think of the last time Ning Ning said that she was playing Yu Ji now and asked him to assist her. As a result, Su Lie's output was higher than her Yu Ji, but he was not disappointed. After all, Ning Ning was just the king, and he could kill casually just for fun.

He responded first.

[Okay, but I don’t know when it will end yet. I’m having a class meeting.】

After replying to the message, Chen Zhou found that Li Dong and Guo Zifeng were looking at him with pleading expressions, and he asked doubtfully.

"What are you talking about?"

After all, Guo Zifeng and Li Dong were asking for help, so they repeated what they just said.

"Hey, Brother Chen, if a girl wants to hang out in your dormitory, bring her buddies."
